title: NAURA broad equipment revenue
definition: Explicit observation selection; revisions remain in the underlying ledger.
limitations: Includes semiconductor and vacuum/new-energy equipment. FY2025 is on a company reporting perimeter that includes KINGSEMI from 2025-06-30, whereas prior years are not; use as an evidence collection, not a constant-perimeter growth series. Not etch revenue or organic growth.

title: NAURA original and restated company revenue
definition: Explicit observation selection; revisions remain in the underlying ledger.
limitations: Original and revised versions coexist; do not sum or treat both as independent revenue.

title: NAURA FY2025 etch and deposition revenue bounds
definition: Separate broad equipment categories reported as exceeding RMB10bn each.
limitations: Lower bounds, not exact point values or TSV-only revenue; consolidation perimeter applies.

title: NAURA annual financial evidence / net profit attributable
definition: Reported financial levels and explicit historical vintages; not a constant-perimeter time series.
limitations: Common-control restatement and KINGSEMI consolidation change reporting perimeters. FY2023 original/restated profit and cash flow both retained. Do not sum NAURA with standalone KINGSEMI. Management R&D investment and financial-note expenditure totals are different reported concepts; no bridge inferred.

title: NAURA H1 2025 equipment-family revenue bounds
definition: Four source-reported category revenue lower bounds from the H1 2025 report.
limitations: Not exact components or market shares. Wet-equipment revenue explicitly excludes KINGSEMI. No inferred allocation among subtypes or parent/subsidiary aggregate exception.

title: NAURA FY2023–FY2024 operational and product evidence
definition: Source-defined shipment, model, customer, order, family-revenue, customer-concentration and equipment-specification records; existing cumulative shipment aliases included explicitly.
limitations: Overlapping groups and lower bounds must not be summed or subtracted as exact components. CVD includes source-listed ALD; vertical furnaces include deposition. Sales differ from shipments and installations; customer ranks are anonymous and year-specific. Report-context dates are flagged where not explicitly stated.

title: NAURA FY2023–FY2024 monetary operating tables
definition: Complete selected monetary sales/production/inventory grids, including both annual columns and printed year-on-year changes.
limitations: Values printed in yuan are not tool counts. Production/inventory valuation basis remains source-defined; inventory is not assumed to equal net balance-sheet inventory. Components are explicitly non-equipment. Comparative source vintages and overlapping levels must not be summed.

title: NAURA FY2025 source-native operating measurements
definition: FY2025 original disclosure milestones, product configuration and monetary operating tables, preserving source-native quantities and periods.
limitations: Shipment and delivery counts overlap; ordinal milestones are not closing totals; configurable chambers are not delivered chambers. Monetary grids are not physical volume. Comparative source vintages are not organic growth or additive totals.

title: NAURA H1 2026 industrial furnace specifications
definition: Issuer-reported maximum process temperatures of hot-press sintering and continuous graphitization furnace families.
limitations: Industrial materials/component-processing specifications, not wafer-tool capacity or factory output. Report-context dates are inferred; process temperature differs from the earlier equipment-temperature claim.
